<details><summary>AI review</summary>

Reviewed at 968989b

The change looks right. I checked the Fetch side: for an iframe with no CORP header under `require-corp`, the *cross-origin resource policy internal check* falls back to `same-origin`, and an opaque origin never matches that. data: and about:blank inherit the parent's policy container, so they still pass *check a navigation response's adherence to its embedder policy*. The PR fixes #13086 fully and doesn't open a COEP hole.

**Suggestions**

- Commit message: it only mentions about:blank and data:, but blob: changes too. A cross-origin iframe that navigates itself to its own blob: URL used to be blocked, because the container document isn't same origin with the blob URL's origin. Now it's allowed. That matches Chromium, which skips blob: and data: explicitly ([`navigation_request.cc:11278`](https://source.chromium.org/chromium/chromium/src/+/main:content/browser/renderer_host/navigation_request.cc;l=11278)). It also matches Gecko, which only runs CORP in `HttpBaseChannel::ProcessCrossOriginResourcePolicyHeader`. Consider mentioning blob: in the commit message. Also add a wpt for it: `blob.https.html` only loads blobs in a same-origin parent, so it doesn't cover this case.
- `source:111360-111363`: the note below the step only explains why the parent is used. Consider adding a sentence on why non-HTTP(S) responses are skipped: they have no `Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy` header, and their documents inherit a policy container that the embedder policy adherence check covers. This also matches Fetch, which only runs the CORP check in *HTTP fetch*.

**Nits**

- `source:111343-111351`: the step now chains four inline conditions. Consider "If all of the following are true:" with a list.

</details>

> AI review

Ah, that's a good point raised by 🤖 for  Blob URLs, seems like that has uncovered an interop difference as safari doesn't pass the test. Will change the checklist 

Edit: applied all suggestions / nit

<details><summary>AI review and fixes</summary>

Reviewed at febd5a0, with web-platform-tests/wpt#64047 at 524932b

The new changes look good. I ran the new test plus `blob`, `data`, and `non-initial-about-blank` in Chrome Canary, Firefox Nightly, and Safari TP. The new test passes in Chrome and Firefox. It times out in Safari TP, and passes there without the top-level COEP header, so it fails for the right reason. I checked the fix with lint and a build.

**Nits**

- `source:111367-111369`: the note says documents from non-HTTP(S) responses inherit their embedder policy, but file: responses get it from the response. Fixed in 5e75eb28 by pointing to *check a navigation response's adherence to its embedder policy* instead, which covers all of them.

</details>
